fields.label: Describe the image you want
fields.value: Create one premium ecommerce lifestyle photo for this food storage container. Keep the exact product shape, materials, color, label, and proportions unchanged. Place it in an organized pantry counter with the container open beside its lid and a small amount of dry food inside. Keep the empty shape, lid seal, stack height, and what fits inside fully visible and sharp. Make the product the main focus with realistic light, believable shadows, clean composition, and room for a crop. Do not add invented readable text, claims, extra products, watermarks, retailer logos, or a plain empty background.
